name: AgentMemory
description: Persistent memory layer for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, etc.) that captures, compresses, and indexes agent sessions to provide cross-session context. Reduces token usage by 92% while maintaining searchable memory across coding sessions.
community_quotes: The cross-session forgetting problem is real - every AI coding session starts from zero
Up to 95% fewer tokens per session, 200x more tool calls before hitting context limits
Gets 95.2% R@5 and 98.6% R@10 on LongMemEval-S retrieval suite
100% open source, free to run locally, no external database required

name: Raindrop Workshop
description: Open-source, local debugger for AI agents that streams every token and tool call for debugging. First dedicated local debugging tool specifically designed for AI agents with MCP-native integration and one-command installation.
community_quotes: Hit 200 GitHub stars on the first day of launch
First dedicated local debugging tool specifically designed for AI agents
Debug AI agents locally without relying on cloud-based dashboards

name: Cline SDK
description: Plugin-based open-source runtime for building coding agents. Allows developers to create custom AI coding agents with a modular, extensible architecture.
community_quotes: Build coding agents with a plugin-based open-source runtime
Open-source runtime for building custom coding agents

name: OpenHuman
description: Open-source AI agent/harness with persistent memory across sessions. Local-first, privacy-first with 118+ integrations (Gmail, Slack, Notion, GitHub). Features a Memory Tree system that canonicalizes context and includes a built-in code sandbox.
community_quotes: 8000+ GitHub stars, 5000+ users in first 7 days
Reached #1 on Product Hunt daily leaderboard May 15, 2026
Two-minute setup, no config files, simple GUI anyone can use
118+ integrations including GitHub with built-in code sandbox

name: OpenClaw OS
description: Turns one-off AI chat sessions into persistent, reusable applications. Open-source tool that converts ephemeral AI agent interactions into usable apps for developers.
community_quotes: Turns one-off chats into persistent apps
Open source tool for converting ephemeral AI sessions into reusable applications
